title: Complete `plugins.rs` — safe plugin discovery + load
resolution: Completed safe, compile-time plugin discovery in prompt-hub/src/plugins.rs WITHOUT unsafe — #![forbid(unsafe_code)] preserved crate-wide, no libloading/dlopen. Mechanism (behind the existing `plugins` feature, which provides the `inventory` dep): added `PluginDescriptor { name, constructor }` collected via `inventory::collect!(PluginDescriptor)`; a `#[macro_export] register_plugin!(name, ctor)` declarative macro that does `inventory::submit!` (re-exported `inventory` from lib.rs as `$crate::inventory` so downstream plugin crates need no direct dep); `discover_plugins() -> Vec<Box<dyn Plugin>>` that iterates `inventory::iter::<PluginDescriptor>` and constructs each; and `PluginRegistry::discover(&mut self) -> Result<usize>` that discovers, registers (calls initialize), and returns the count. Wired/reachable: the prompthub CLI `plugin list` command now calls `registry.discover()` (cfg(feature=plugins)) alongside the existing runtime `load_static_plugins()` path — both kept (NO-DOWNGRADE: the prior Mutex-based runtime registry and register_from_path static fallback are untouched). True dynamic .so loading documented as intentionally out of scope under forbid(unsafe_code); the inventory link-time registry IS the safe discovery path. Tests added in plugins.rs: a DiscoveredPlugin submitted via register_plugin! at crate scope; test_discover_plugins_finds_submitted_descriptor (discovery surfaces the descriptor) and test_registry_discover_registers_and_invokes (discover registers+initializes, list reflects it, health invoked, all_healthy true). Gates all green: cargo build -p prompt-hub (default) OK; cargo test -p prompt-hub --all-features plugins = 7 passed; cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings = clean; cargo clippy -p prompt-hub --all-targets -- -D warnings (default) = clean; cargo fmt -p prompt-hub --check = clean; cargo build --workspace --all-features OK (181 crates).
objective: INCOMPLETE FEATURE (not dead code): plugins.rs (306 lines) has a PluginRegistry with list/register, but discovery/loading is unfinished under #![forbid(unsafe_code)]. COMPLETE it: implement SAFE, compile-time plugin discovery (e.g. the `inventory` crate / linkme-style registration already hinted by the `plugins` feature) so registered plugins are discovered and invoked through the registry — no unsafe dynamic loading. Upgrade only — finish safe plugin support; do not gate the feature out.
acceptance_criteria: PluginRegistry discovers compile-time-registered plugins via a safe mechanism (no unsafe)
a registered plugin can be looked up and invoked through the registry
a test registers + discovers + invokes a sample plugin
policy_note: Owner directive 2026-06-13: NO DOWNGRADES. A module that looks like dead code / an old feature is an INCOMPLETE feature to be completed — never removed or gated out. Upgrade only.
